method.pageNumbers: PDF pages are one-based. Section ranges include the source page of the next boundary when content shares that page.
method.similarity: Dice overlap of normalized word trigram multisets. Glyph order, typesetting, and pagination can lower overlap. Scores do not certify mathematical equivalence or identify every changed formula.
method.sectionRecord: Each edition array gives [start page, boundary page, normalized token count]. Canonical bookmark titles use the printed 18.1 wording.
method.resultRecord: Each named result array gives [kind, v1 printed heading page, v2 printed heading page, normalized trigram overlap up to the next result or outline marker]. The overlap is omitted for additions and for Lemma 6.42, whose PDF text geometry did not yield a reliable window.
method.destinations: Common destination names can resolve to changed content. Apply explicit remapping for revision-sensitive equation and moved native result targets. Hfootnote and Item IDs are internal generated counters.
